clause_3.note: pre-arm corpse landings MUST be > 0 or the rig never reached the mechanism and a 0 post-arm proves nothing (Discipline #11)

roll_then_discard_check.why: Q-1 roll-then-discard: ATTEMPT counts must be IDENTICAL across arms. If attempts fell, the gate moved before the roll and every downstream draw shifted -- which would make a byte-identical Clause-1 result impossible to trust.
